body.html:
Can Tho City, Vietnam — Arshid Ashrith, a 21-year-old third-year MBBS student from Telangana, died in a tragic road accident on Wednesday morning after losing control of his overspeeding bike at a curve and crashing into a house wall. The incident was caught on CCTV.

Ashrith, a native of Kagaznagar and son of cloth merchants, was riding with a friend when the accident occurred. He died on the spot, while his friend suffered serious injuries and is currently receiving treatment.

The shocking death has left Ashrith’s family and local community devastated. Efforts are ongoing to repatriate his body to India. Local authorities have launched an investigation into the crash.

The incident stands as a grim reminder of the global relevance of the road safety slogan — "Speed Thrills, But Kills."

articles.title: Fake Army Captain Runs ₹19 Crore Scam, Dupes 400 Youths with Uniforms, ID Cards & Dreams
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Mainpuri, UP — A massive fake army recruitment scam has been uncovered in Uttar Pradesh’s Mainpuri district, where a fraudulent training centre operated for over four years, deceiving hundreds of youths from multiple states with false promises of military and government jobs.

body.html:
Mainpuri, UP — A massive fake army recruitment scam has been uncovered in Uttar Pradesh’s Mainpuri district, where a fraudulent training centre operated for over four years, deceiving hundreds of youths from multiple states with false promises of military and government jobs.

The centre, spread across a 30-bigha rented plot near Bidhuna crossing, was run by Arvind Kumar Pandey — who falsely claimed to be a retired Army captain and doctor — along with his assistant, Sumitra Senapati. The operation used army flags, fake officers in uniform, and official-looking documents to create an illusion of legitimacy.

Each candidate was charged ₹2–3 lakh, lured by the promise of guaranteed employment in the Army or other security forces. Victims received fake appointment letters, uniforms, ID cards, and in some cases, were placed in low-paying private security jobs. Over 400 youths from Telangana, Haryana, Rajasthan, Uttarakhand, and Odisha are confirmed to have been duped, with the estimated fraud amounting to ₹18–19 crore.

The scam was exposed after a complaint by a youth from Telangana led Kishani police and a surveillance team to raid the centre. Pandey and Senapati were arrested, while five other accomplices remain absconding. Fake documents, national emblems, medical certificates, lease papers, and rubber stamps were seized from the site.

Authorities revealed that Pandey has a history of fraud, including scams linked to a toothpaste brand and a beauty contest. The accused now face charges under multiple sections of the Indian Penal Code, the Indian National Emblem Act, and the Private Security Agencies Regulation Act. Army Intelligence has joined the investigation to assess the full scale and possible regional links of the racket.

articles.title: Former BJP Leader Arrested for Orchestrating Gang-Rape of Her Own 13-Year-Old Daughter
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A former BJP district functionary from Haridwar has been arrested on charges of facilitating the repeated gang-rape of her 13-year-old daughter by her boyfriend and his associate over a three-month period.

body.html:
A former BJP district functionary from Haridwar has been arrested on charges of facilitating the repeated gang-rape of her 13-year-old daughter by her boyfriend and his associate over a three-month period.

The accused mother, who was removed from her BJP post in August 2024 due to prior conduct complaints, allegedly forced her daughter to consume alcohol before the assaults. The abuse occurred between January and March 2025 in multiple locations including Haridwar, Agra, and Vrindavan.

Two suspects have been arrested: the mother and her boyfriend Sumit Patwal. A third accused, Shubham, remains at large. The victim's father discovered the abuse after noticing his daughter's distress and filed a police complaint. Medical examination has confirmed the sexual abuse.

The crimes involved death threats against both the victim and her father to ensure silence. The BJP has officially expelled the woman from the party following the allegations.

Both the mother and her boyfriend are currently in judicial custody while police continue searching for the third suspect.

articles.title: Doctor Brutally Beaten, Tied to Tree in Bihar for Aiding Rape Victim’s Family
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Gaya, Bihar — In a horrifying incident, a doctor was tied to a tree and brutally assaulted in a village in Bihar’s Gaya district. The assault occurred when Dr. Jitendra Yadav visited the home of a rape victim’s mother to provide medical care after learning of her deteriorating health.

body.html:
Gaya, Bihar — In a horrifying incident, a doctor was tied to a tree and brutally assaulted in a village in Bihar’s Gaya district. The assault occurred when Dr. Jitendra Yadav visited the home of a rape victim’s mother to provide medical care after learning of her deteriorating health.

According to reports, 10–12 local goons, allegedly trying to pressure the victim’s family to withdraw the rape case, attacked the doctor for offering help. The mob tied him to a tree and beat him mercilessly, leaving him bleeding and severely injured.

Fearful villagers did not intervene but secretly filmed the assault. One such video, later posted on social media, went viral and caught the attention of authorities. A Dial 112 police team reached the spot and rescued the doctor using a rope. He was rushed to a Community Health Centre for treatment.

Police have confirmed that the doctor was attacked for assisting the rape victim’s family. A case has been registered, and a manhunt is underway for the accused.

Reacting sharply, Leader of Opposition Tejashwi Yadav called the situation in Bihar "worse than Taliban rule." In a post on Instagram and X, he blamed the state’s NDA government for lawlessness, alleging that the police and administration have completely failed to protect citizens.

“In Gaya district, a doctor treating the mother of a rape victim was tied to a tree and beaten to a bloody pulp. In 20 years of corrupt NDA rule, Bihar has become a land where criminals roam free and justice is dead,” Tejashwi said.

articles.title: Truck Allegedly Carrying Cow Meat Set on Fire by Mob, Protesters Demand Encounter of Accused
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Ghaziabad, Uttar Pradesh — Violent clashes broke out late Tuesday night near Amrala village on the Bhojpur-Pilkhuwa Road after a truck allegedly transporting banned meat was intercepted by members of Hindu Yuva Vahini, Bajrang Dal, and local villagers.

body.html:
Ghaziabad, Uttar Pradesh — Violent clashes broke out late Tuesday night near Amrala village on the Bhojpur-Pilkhuwa Road after a truck allegedly transporting banned meat was intercepted by members of Hindu Yuva Vahini, Bajrang Dal, and local villagers.

According to reports, the truck was stopped around 9 PM after activists, led by Neeraj Sharma and Madhur Nehra, received a tip-off. Upon discovering large quantities of meat in the vehicle, the enraged mob vandalized the truck, thrashed the driver and cleaner, and eventually set the vehicle ablaze despite police intervention.

Senior officers, including Bhojpur SHO Amit Sharma and ACP Gyanprakash Rai, arrived at the scene with reinforcements, but the protesters remained defiant, demanding the immediate arrest and 'encounter' of the accused. Firefighters were called in to douse the flames, while JCB machines were used to control the fire using mud.

The situation intensified further as protesters staged a sit-in protest, blocking the Bhojpur-Pilkhuwa Road for nearly two hours, causing widespread traffic disruption.

Veterinary officials have taken meat samples for forensic testing to verify whether it was cow meat. As of now, no official complaint has been filed, but a detailed investigation is underway.

articles.title: Pakistani TikTok Star Sana Yousaf Shot Dead After Rejecting Stalker’s Advances; Honour Killing
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Islamabad, June 2, 2025 — Sana Yousaf, a 17-year-old TikTok star and social media influencer, was shot dead at her home in Islamabad in the presence of her mother and aunt. The gunman, identified as Umar Hayat, fled the scene after shooting her at point-blank range.

body.html:
Islamabad, June 2, 2025 — Sana Yousaf, a 17-year-old TikTok star and social media influencer, was shot dead at her home in Islamabad in the presence of her mother and aunt. The gunman, identified as Umar Hayat, fled the scene after shooting her at point-blank range.

According to Islamabad Police, Hayat, a 22-year-old from Faisalabad, had been obsessively pursuing Sana despite repeated rejections. Police revealed that Hayat had even waited outside her birthday party venue for hours, attempting to meet her. After being turned away multiple times, he forcibly entered her home and killed her.

Inspector General Syed Ali Nasir Rizvi confirmed that the motive appears to be personal rejection. However, authorities are also investigating the possibility of an "honour killing," a phenomenon that remains prevalent in parts of Pakistan, particularly involving women in the public eye.

As of now, all evidence and witness statements point to rejected advances as the primary cause.

articles.title: UP: Madrasa Operator Arrested for Raping Woman Teacher in Bareilly
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Bareilly, Uttar Pradesh — Police in Bareilly’s Fatehganj West area have arrested madrasa operator Zubair on charges of raping a woman teacher. According to police, Zubair called the alim (religious) teacher to the madrasa on a holiday under the pretext of work.

body.html:
Bareilly, Uttar Pradesh — Police in Bareilly’s Fatehganj West area have arrested madrasa operator Zubair on charges of raping a woman teacher.

According to police, Zubair called the alim (religious) teacher to the madrasa on a holiday under the pretext of work. When she failed to return home, her family reached the madrasa and found her lying unconscious.

Locals, enraged by the incident, reportedly thrashed Zubair on the spot. A video of the public beating has since gone viral on social media.

The survivor was taken for medical examination, which confirmed rape. Based on the family’s complaint, police registered a case and arrested Zubair. He has been sent to jail. Further investigation is ongoing.
